Around ₹35 crore has allegedly vanished from the accounts of customers at a Punjab National Bank branch in Greater Noida. Police have registered an FIR after 25 customers filed complaints over missing funds. Several bank employees have reportedly been suspended. Among those affected are families who say they have lost their life savings, land compensation and fixed deposits. Watch
